description: Mark leased inbox messages done (terminal — acked messages are never replayed). Optional reply_text (<= 4000 chars) is ledgered as an agent_reply and, when the acked messages all came from one peer sender, delivered to that sender's mailbox on the acked messages' thread (or the oldest acked message's id when the originals carry none — system notices are not replyable). Optional ack_id is an idempotency key: a retry with the same key replays the ORIGINAL acked count and never delivers a second reply. Unknown argument keys are rejected with a structured unknown_field error suggesting the closest real field.

inputSchema.description:
Mark leased messages done (``mailbox_ack``, terminal).

Strict-fields loop: unknown argument keys 422 as a structured
``unknown_field`` error.

ack_body.description: Optional structured ack payload {nonce, body_hash}. REQUIRED for probe messages: nonce must echo the probe's nonce and body_hash must be sha256(nonce + body) — a mismatch is a structured probe_nonce_mismatch / probe_body_hash_mismatch error. Persisted verbatim on non-probe messages.
ack_body.title: Ack Body

ack_id.description: Optional idempotency key (1-128 chars, non-blank). A retry carrying the same ack_id replays the ORIGINAL acked count and never delivers a second reply — use it when the transport ate your ack's response.
ack_id.title: Ack Id

reply_text.description: Optional reply (<= 4000 chars). Ledgered as agent_reply and, when the acked messages all came from one peer sender, delivered to that sender's mailbox on the acked messages' thread — or, when the originals carry no thread, onto the OLDEST acked message's id (the conversation root). System notices are not replyable.
reply_text.title: Reply Text
